meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 Claude 加上个人微信通道:通过腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 长轮询,用手机扫码登录你的微信号,之后它能接收微信私聊和群消息并回复。
howto.when: 当你在 NanoClaw 里运行 add-wechat 技能,或在 /setup 流程中接入微信通道时接管。需要个人微信号和手机扫码登录。

say.text: 帮我把微信通道接进来,扫码登录我的个人微信
say.note: 复制适配器、装依赖,再打印二维码链接

say.text: 用 wire-dm 脚本把这个微信消息组接到我的 agent group
say.note: 脚本列出未接线的微信消息组让你选

say.text: 微信登录过期了,帮我删掉 auth.json 重新扫码
say.note: 删除后重启服务会要求重新扫码

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to Claude via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. After you scan a QR code to log in, it long-polls incoming DMs and group messages and replies to them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run the add-wechat skill, or when you add the WeChat channel during /setup. You need a personal WeChat account and a phone to scan the login QR code.

say_en.text: Add the WeChat channel and log in my personal account by QR scan
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, prints the QR URL

say_en.text: Wire this WeChat messaging group to my agent group using wire-dm
say_en.note: Script lists unwired WeChat messaging groups to pick from

say_en.text: My WeChat session expired — delete auth.json so I can re-scan
say_en.note: Restarting after deletion asks for a new QR scan
